_comment: Operator capability-bus v0 registry — machine-readable list of skills operator_cli.py can dispatch to. status: live = runs directly under this hub's own process control; delegate = forwarded as-is to an existing engine (tbcc_cli.py) that already owns the logic — do not reimplement a delegate's behavior here. corpora: local files worth reading for context on that skill, not a live API — see tbcc/docs/OPERATOR_CAPABILITY_BUS.md for why this is local transferable context rather than a Context7-style cloud doc source.

skills.description: Docs-vs-behavior mismatch / hidden-Unicode / injection-bait scanner for a local path or URL (GitHub repo/tree/blob, gist, pastebin raw).
Supply-chain / deception triage before vendoring — runs semantic-scan then install-hook / workflow-write / opaque-base64 heuristics. Not malware confirmation.
Public HTML feature inventory + stack footprint for a URL (chat, store, payments, APIs/CDNs). Writes FEATURES.md/STACK.md under aesthetic-research. Not a private backend dump.
Aesthetic harvest for a URL (fonts, colors, radii, motion hints). Writes BRIEF/TOKENS/MOTION under aesthetic-research. Harvest only — Transfer/Rebuild stay in Cursor skill.

Probes a host for open directory listings, inventories config/secret files, reports verified exposures (LIVE/stale/unverified). Read-only GET; redacted output. Run on the target site tab — not a social post about it.
VirusTotal URL or local-file hash reputation via Vault VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY. Engine tallies only — not malware confirmation.
RSS/Atom research scanner + feed source registry — fetch, dedupe, SPRINT_STATE match, and feed-add/feed-list for the source list itself.
Local LLM provider/model index and sticky rotator — status, next, ask, keys, models. Do not rebuild; forward to the existing engine.
API Pocket — PC-local REST service-slot registry (add/list/show/call/remove/suggest). The operator's "mechanical arm" for ad-hoc API calls. Do not rebuild; forward to the existing engine.
Unified operator terminal (Textual) — one persistent multi-tab app over the LLM index, API Pocket key paste-register+test, affiliate-link upload, and semantic-scan. `operator tui` from anywhere.

Pause/restore local bandwidth hogs (OneDrive, MEGAsync, Dropbox, Drive, iCloud, Steam downloads, Windows Update/DO, Discord/Spotify updaters, download managers) and show a WiFi snapshot. Until-restore. Desktop right-click via tbcc/tools/register-wifi-focus-context-menu.ps1.
Readonly class-2 silent-fail probes (intake last_run, storage-hub R2 export, enrich-backlog last_success). Verdicts: ok|stale|never_seen|idle|blocked. No Start bots.
